fields_4.notesHeading: Notes:- After completion of connectorisation and insulation checks (minimum 0.2M Ohms with 100V Megger), switch on control supply. Before starting Interlock checks No.2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, & 9 ensure the following things:
notesItems: a) All control station Main & reserve supply ON
b) Control lever at IDLE position (actuator & Scale at 26-28). IDLE indication should glow
c) Decoupler engaged / ready for engagement.
d) Boost exhaust doors open (Boost exhaust doors OPEN indication at CCC panel)
e) Boost RG barring device at disengaged position.
f) Start selector switch at START / COLD CRANKING or FALSE START position.
